title: The Interruption
staging:
Scene 02 — The Interruption

01:10–02:00 · 50 sec · Resistance hideout

The game freezes during a critical mission. A loud corporate announcement overrides the screen.

Shots: TV glitch close-up → controller button-mashing → Trixie's irritated face → entire crew reacting.

lines.speaker: Trixie
lines.text: What the fuck? We were almost done!

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: Why do the dogs always have to interrupt our fun?

lines.speaker: Neon
lines.text: The console is still running. Look, my controller is connected. Something is taking over the television.
